input: Hash-bound accepted T03 scene, source binding, four native T03 audits and captured policies
phases: Construct source-derived 25 percent route profiles and editable bulk; execute native proposal and complete final checks
Bind the accepted route and bulk operands as an immutable content-addressed geometry floor
Construct optional side-specific additions at fixed accepted route poses; execute fresh proposal and complete final checks

scope.bounded: Explicit unique native route IDs, at most 128
scope.full_board: No route-ID filter; complete native admission and source-role projection; requires code/input/policy-bound bounded qualification

ownership.original_source: Immutable refs and native identities retained, including zero-contribution aliases and authorized bulk tombstones
ownership.route: Connected native route, distinct from local parallel group
ownership.bulk: Existing source-role classifier and original-owner index, independent of chosen mutable route set
ownership.side_floor: Every accepted route and changed-bulk contribution retained exactly; accepted poses fixed
ownership.neighbor_index: Complete floor, maximum body and optional-extension bounds plus checking headroom; every candidate must fit its prepared bound. Symmetric source-radius bounds are insufficient for side growth.

reuse.source_preparation: Once per job, hash-bound source roles and catalogue shared across both phases
reuse.side_witnesses: Positive immutable shape/recipe hashes only, at most 128 entries per table; cleared at construction boundaries
reuse.changed_geometry_policy: Exact binding miss or explicit rejection; never reuse a decision for changed geometry
reuse.planning_candidate_eligibility: All admissible immutable recipes survive independently of mutable route count, cache budget and residency. No memory-derived top-N cutoff.
reuse.planning_candidate_miss: Reconstruct exact geometry and verify WKB including SRID, precision, bounds and estimated weight. An oversized shape is used without caching; reconstruction mismatch is fatal.
reuse.planning_candidate_accounting: The LRU covers geometry reuse only; active source/chosen geometry and lightweight recipes are separate. Budget counters are operational progress, not native proof authority.

checks: Per-proposal physical/functional clearance, source cores and source voids
Complete nominal and envelope scenes in both phases
Actual pre-motion foreign-owner gaps and protected terminal partition
Both source width caps, route width band and side-cell cap witnesses
Serialized material hash and original identity custody
Accepted-state proof-chain transition for every native proposal
failure: Exclusive attempt latch; retain FAIL and artifacts, no retry/resume or acceptance promotion
reports: Existing per-proposal and final-check contracts, plus source_built_profile with baseline ref, floor digest, retention and phase wall times
scope_authority: RESULT.scope and limiting_construction.scope select execution scope; RESULT.full_board_run records an actual whole-board execution. Historical nested planner labels are retained for report compatibility and do not enable or qualify a board run.
optional_cap_rejection: Record rejected width sections, discard an uncertifiable supplement, revalidate the exact accepted floor, then execute all native proposal and final checks
timing: Include source intake, construction, shared setup, both native ladders, both complete final checks, floor binding and publication; archive/visual audit separately
profile_factor_semantics: Factors denote progress toward a pre-capped profile. Fallback candidate physical width fields and eligibility derive from the profile band; do not multiply source width by progress as a second physical enlargement.
equal_width_construction: Use the single exact lower/upper buffer when the bands coincide. Do not clip and union a redundant subset on coincident boundaries.
candidate_overlay_failure: Record and reject an invalid optional planning candidate. No snapping, geometry repair, clearance waiver or acceptance promotion.
candidate_scaling_qualification: Candidate eligibility is independent of the geometry-cache budget and route count. Tests must include zero bytes, oversized entries, eviction and changed-reconstruction rejection. Previous bounded manifests do not qualify changed code.
